release.args_gn:
target_os = "linux"
target_cpu = "x64"
is_debug = false
is_component_build = false
use_sysroot = true
release.purpose: Original release configuration and existing view identity; no profile overlays.

dev.args_gn:
target_os = "linux"
target_cpu = "x64"
is_debug = false
is_component_build = false
use_sysroot = true
symbol_level = 0
v8_symbol_level = 0
blink_symbol_level = 0
dev.purpose: Low optimization development iteration only. Release assertions and target selection stay unchanged; the C/C++ default/max/speed optimization aliases use O0 and Rust opt-level is explicitly zero. Section and linker garbage-collection flags remain enabled. Use release for performance measurements and publication. Opus alone appends -O1 through its private config, after the speed config; other codec and engine diagnostics remain enabled.

replacements.new:
# Standalone development: the codec needs basic optimization at runtime.
  cflags = [ "-O1" ]

configs += [ "//build/config/compiler:optimize_speed" ]

    # Apply the codec-specific development optimization after optimize_speed.
    configs -= [ ":opus_private_config" ]
    configs += [ ":opus_private_config" ]

incremental_upgrades.reason: Keep Opus at O1 without changing Blink/V8 O0 settings or disabling compiler diagnostics; preserve completed outputs in the existing development view.
